title: ShipmentRequest
description: A sender's request to have one or more FreightPackages transported, with handling and delivery requirements, written to the sender's eVault. Carriers answer it with TransportOffers. A clarification creates a new ShipmentRequest that `refines` the earlier one; the earlier request is not changed. Closest schema.org types: Demand, with ParcelDelivery properties for addresses and items. The clarification conversation itself uses the existing Message schema.

authorId.description: eName of the sender who made the request

localLabel.description: Human-readable label used by the sender, e.g. 'SR-417'

recipientEName.description: eName of the receiver, if known

recipientName.description: Receiver's name as given by the sender

shockLimitScope.description: Whether maxShockG applies during transport only, or also during warehouse and port handling

preferredDeliveryDays.description: Preferred delivery time, in days from pickup

latestDeliveryDays.description: Latest acceptable delivery time, in days from pickup

refines.description: The earlier ShipmentRequest this one replaces after clarification, as w3ds://envelope?id=@<ename>/<metaEnvelopeId>

updatedAt.description: When the record was last updated
